posts.caption:
The labels want DistroKid's AI numbers 🤖

Sony and UMG asked a Manhattan federal court to make DistroKid hand over monthly data on how many uploads its software flags as AI made, as part of their case against Suno. DistroKid says it's a third party and its AI detection can be wrong. Should distributors have to show how much of what they upload is AI?
